information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits only an analysis that synthesizes generative evidence against normative obligations. The final call consumes that analysis, directly receives only task, anchor_contract, and task_constraints, has no direct visibility of anchor_policy, candidate_hypothesis, or loop_structure, and emits one complete policy.
name: Permanent Source-Class Cut
organization: two-call sequential lineage with an unconditional generative-source cut on the terminal edge

calls.objective: Reconcile inherited and counter-generative claims against normative obligations, preserve conflicts and supporting distinctions, and emit only an analysis without creating a policy artifact.
Consume synthesize_cut_sources, directly reconcile its claims with the visible normative inputs, and emit one complete policy without reacquiring the cut generative sources.
